description: This file defines the MailProcessor interface within the OrangeHRM Core Mail plugin. It specifies methods for retrieving email content replacements and recipient lists based on various parameters, facilitating email processing in the system.

classes.name: MailProcessor
classes.description: An interface that outlines methods for processing email templates and recipients in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Returns an array of replacements for email content based on email name, recipient, roles, and event.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Returns an array of AbstractRecipient objects representing the recipients for a specific email and roles based on the event.
